paite: Ka hinna aw, TOUPA phat inla; ka sung a om tengteng aw, amin siangthou phat in!
heading: Pathian Itna David Phatna La

paite: Ka hinna aw, TOUPA phat inla, athil hihhoih tengteng mangngilh ke'n.
Ama'n na thulimlouhna tengteng angaidam a; na natna tengteng ahihdam hi.
Manthatna lak a kipan na hinna atan a; zahngaihna leh lainatnate ahon khusak hi.
Na kam thil hoih in ataisak a; huchi in na valnouna muvanlai bang in siam thak in a-om nawn hi.
TOUPA'N, nuaisiahna thuak tengteng a ding in thil kizente hihsak in, vai ahawmsak nak hi.
Alampite Mosi atheisak a, athilhihte Israel suante leng atheisak hi.
TOUPA lainatna a dim, mihehpih theitak, lungneltak, zahngaihna hautak ahi.
Ama'n atai kei ding a; ahehna apai nilouh sam kei ding hi.
I khelhnate bang in i tung uah ahih kei a, i thulimlouhnate bang in ahon thuk sam kei hi.
Van, leitung sangtak a a-om bang in, amah laute tung ah azahngaihna alian mahmah ahi.
Suahlam leh tumlam a kigamlat bang in, i tatleknate tuh eimah a kipan in akoihmangta hi.
Pa'n atate ahehpih bang in, TOUPA'N amah laute ahehpih hi.
I pumpi kibawlkhiakdan athei a; leivui lel i hi chih atheih ziak in.
Mihing damsung nite loupa bang ahi a; loubuk a pak bang in alun hi.
Huih in amut a, amang hi; a-omna mun in athei nawnta kei ding hi.
TOUPA zahngaihna bel amah kihtate tung ah tangtawn a pan tangtawn pha in a-om ding a, adiktatna leng ata suan atu suan tan un a-om ding hi.
Athukhun zui peuhmahte leh, athuhilhte man tum a theigige peuhmahte tung ah.
TOUPA'N alaltutphah van ah ahihkip a; agam in bangkim tung ah vai ahawm hi.
Athu ngaikhia a, athu mang nou a-angelte aw, hatna a thupite aw, TOUPA phat un.
Asepaihte aw, adeihlam hih a nasemte aw, TOUPA phat un.
Avaihawmna mun peuhmah a athilhih tengteng aw, TOUPA phat un; ka hinna aw, TOUPA phat in.
